name: DISABLE TEREDO
description: Disables the Teredo IPv6 tunneling protocol.
command: netsh interface teredo set state disabled
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = netsh interface teredo show state 2>&1; if ($r -match 'disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE IPV6
description: Completely disables IPv6 stack on all network interfaces.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters' -Name 'DisabledComponents' -ErrorAction Stop).DisabledComponents; if ($v -eq 255) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: PREFER IPV4 OVER IPV6
description: Configures the system to prefer IPv4 over IPv6 when both are available.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters' -Name 'DisabledComponents' -ErrorAction Stop).DisabledComponents; if ($v -eq 32) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE NAGLES ALGORITHM
description: Disables Nagle's algorithm for lower TCP latency.
command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$keys = Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces'; foreach ($k in $keys) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $k.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force }"
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$keys = Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces'; if (-not $keys) { exit 1 }; $ok = 1; foreach ($k in $keys) { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $k.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).TcpAckFrequency; if ($v -ne 1) { $ok = 0; break } }; if ($ok -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE TCP NODELAY
description: Enables TCP_NODELAY to send packets immediately without delay.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters' -Name 'TcpNoDelay' -ErrorAction Stop).TcpNoDelay; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE RSS
description: Disables Receive Side Scaling for single-core network processing.
command: netsh int tcp set global rss=disabled
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = netsh int tcp show global 2>&1; if ($r -match 'RSS\s+:\s+disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE RSC
description: Disables Receive Segment Coalescing to reduce network latency.
command: netsh int tcp set global rsc=disabled
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = netsh int tcp show global 2>&1; if ($r -match 'RSC\s+:\s+disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE AUTOTUNINGLEVEL
description: Disables TCP autotuning for consistent network buffer sizes.
command: netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=disabled
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = netsh int tcp show global 2>&1; if ($r -match 'Auto-Tuning Level\s+:\s+disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE QOS PACKET SCHEDULER
description: Removes the QoS bandwidth limit to allow full network throughput.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Psched' -Name 'NonBestEffortLimit' -ErrorAction Stop).NonBestEffortLimit; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: USE CLOUDFLARE DNS
description: Sets all network adapters to use Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1).
command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$adapters = Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($a in $adapters) { Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.InterfaceIndex -ServerAddresses ('1.1.1.1','1.0.0.1') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $a = Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1; $d = Get-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.InterfaceIndex -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction Stop; if ($d.ServerAddresses -contains '1.1.1.1') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE ECN
description: Disables Explicit Congestion Notification for lower network latency.
command: netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = netsh int tcp show global 2>&1; if ($r -match 'ECN Capability\s+:\s+disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE TCP TIMESTAMPS
description: Disables TCP timestamps for reduced packet overhead.
command: netsh int tcp set global timestamps=disabled
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = netsh int tcp show global 2>&1; if ($r -match 'Timestamps\s+:\s+disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
